mechanism: Celecoxib may inhibit haloperidol metabolism via CYP2D6 and CYP3A4, increasing haloperidol levels; NSAIDs also increase risk of hyponatremia and CNS effects; haloperidol increases seizure risk which NSAIDs may potentiate.
action: Monitor for haloperidol toxicity signs (extrapyramidal effects, QT prolongation, hyponatremia); consider alternative NSAID or dose adjustment; ensure adequate hydration and electrolyte monitoring.
